info.title: Origin Trace local HTTP API
info.description: Source-backed description of the Origin Trace Rust backend HTTP interface. Not a new server or a promise of full native-app parity. No credential authentication is implemented. Every /api/ request and every POST requires Host to name localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1 with the exact listening port; cross-site Sec-Fetch-Site is rejected. If Origin is present it must be HTTP, local, same port, without credentials/query/fragment. Nonbrowser CLI clients can omit Origin. Use local access only. Schemas explicitly marked partial retain source-specific gaps; x-max-utf8-bytes is documentary, not a standard JSON Schema validator keyword.

servers.description: Default development endpoint. Native sessions may choose an ephemeral port; use their endpoint file, do not assume 7319.

get.description: First read for a connected agent. Reports live_admission, capture mode, the health instance id, and up to 16 retained Wasm artifacts from a 256 KiB manifest tail, without fetching bytecode. Debugger fields are fixed retirement values since CDP was removed. The HTTP API cannot know client effects flags: allow_effects is null; reb-api mcp fills its actual invocation admission. live_admission is availability, not authorization. Cache the context with its own ETag.

get.description: May calculate and write local analysis cache even on GET. Optional exact native request projection requires request_id, session_id, root_process_id and root_sequence_number together, or all four omitted. It selects only an explicit request-start to response-start to acknowledged captured response-body chain; absent or ambiguous linkage yields no matching results, never a URL/time/CDP heuristic or related_request_ids fallback. related_request_ids remains correlation, not causation. A 304 check happens after loading analysis; the full selector is included in the ETag.

500.description: Store, read, validation, or internal failure.

400.description: Invalid, blank, duplicate, zero, out-of-range, or incomplete exact request selectors; supply all four selectors together or omit all four.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Exact native request identifier, not a CDP request identifier. Canonical nonzero uint64 decimal string. Optional only as a complete set with request_id, session_id, root_process_id and root_sequence_number; otherwise omit all four. Invalid, blank, duplicate, zero, or out-of-range values return 400.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Exact native root event session identifier. Canonical nonzero uint64 decimal string. Optional only as a complete set with request_id, session_id, root_process_id and root_sequence_number; otherwise omit all four. Invalid, blank, duplicate, zero, or out-of-range values return 400.

parameters.name: root_process_id
parameters.description: Exact native request-start process identifier. Canonical nonzero uint32 decimal value. Optional only as a complete set with request_id, session_id, root_process_id and root_sequence_number; otherwise omit all four. Invalid, blank, duplicate, zero, or out-of-range values return 400.

parameters.name: root_sequence_number
parameters.description: Exact native request-start sequence number. Canonical nonzero uint64 decimal string. Optional only as a complete set with request_id, session_id, root_process_id and root_sequence_number; otherwise omit all four. Invalid, blank, duplicate, zero, or out-of-range values return 400.

post.summary: Validate an inert supplied evidence package
post.description: Checks a caller-supplied metadata package without resolving references or treating it as backend evidence. Any JSON object is accepted for bounded validation; the expected valid document is EvidencePackage. Structurally parseable package failures return HTTP 200 with status invalid or unsupported. Duplicate object members return invalid/duplicate_json_key before materialization. Malformed JSON or a nonobject outer body returns HTTP 400. Unknown member names and raw input are never echoed. There is no export, import, installation, package persistence, source access, or authenticity claim.

requestBody.description: The package document itself, never a path or URL. One decimal Content-Length is required; 1..4194304 bytes. No Transfer-Encoding. The runtime accepts JSON objects outside the expected schema in order to report invalid or unsupported packages.

post.summary: Export selected metadata from cooperatively stopped evidence stores
post.description: Reads only explicitly selected configured source sections, under shared nonblocking lifetime guards. Updated broker and artifact receiver writers must have exited. A missing legacy guard is unsupported; socket absence or a stop request is not a snapshot. Full bounded source scans establish exact selections, reference coverage and duplicates; full selected artifact byte hashes are verified. The response omits raw payloads, URLs, paths, headers, bodies and artifact bytes. Advisory leases do not protect against malicious same-user or privileged writers. No source execution, capture control, persistence, network access or retries.

post.summary: Inspect or compare explicit binary32 buffers
post.description: Version 1 read-only diagnostics. Inputs are exact hex word arrays, canonical base64 bytes, or ID-selected complete verified artifacts. Layout is explicitly interleaved float32-le or float32-be. Omitted/null reference inspects one input. Caller tolerances use absolute OR symmetric relative OR finite representable-step distance; they never establish behavioral equivalence. Full metrics cover all supplied samples; detail is a bounded window. NaN representations remain raw bits, signed zeros are numerically equal, and nonfinite values are excluded from deltas/ULP/tolerances. No native capture, browser/CPU attribution, arbitrary paths/URLs, network, helper, or persistence.

200.description: Complete bounded binary32 diagnostics. Inspect comparison status; empty or mismatched layouts do not yield full equality. Null finite metrics are unavailable, never nonfinite-to-JSON coercions.

post.summary: Compare two supplied evidence metadata packages
post.description: Read-only bounded comparison after strict validation of both original package byte tokens. Rejects malformed, duplicate, unsupported, contradictory or oversized input; unsupported observer/profile data cannot be coerced into comparable evidence. Explicit facets and normalization are part of deterministic identity. Exact declared session/process keys may align metadata; coincident IDs across sessions remain unmatched or ambiguous. No raw artifact-byte verification, capture-completeness, behavioral, causal or timing-equivalence claim. Results page deterministic rows and preserve unknown capture settings. No evidence store reads, helpers, browser actions, persistence, automatic export or network access. A shared package permit is reserved with nonblocking admission before comparison-body ingestion and transferred through blocking work, limiting simultaneously retained comparison bodies/work to two. Busy requests receive 503/resource_limit before their bodies are read.

requestBody.description: One Content-Length, no Transfer-Encoding, at most 8392704 request bytes; each original nested package token at most 4194304 bytes. Required explicit profile and 1..7 unique facets; offset 0..2181 and limit 1..100.

200.description: At most 524288 bytes; full bounded summary plus one deterministic page, at most 100 rows. Unknown observer regimes and missing records never establish unchanged capture or behavior.

400.description: Invalid framing or comparison options, rejected original package (including duplicate keys, digest/reference/profile errors), or resource limits. No input or unrecognized fields are echoed.

408.description: Body, admission or cooperative comparison deadline exceeded. No successful partial comparison is returned.

500.description: Local validation worker or contract initialization failed.

503.description: Comparison capacity is full (resource_limit) before request body ingestion, or package admission infrastructure is closed (dependency_unavailable). At most two package operations may reserve comparison bodies/work; rejection does not read/retain the large body and is not an automatic retry instruction. An HTTP client still uploading after early rejection may instead observe a transport error.

staticEvidenceClass.description: Static dispatch structure. A br_table or call_indirect site is never a proven guest ISA.

structuralEvidenceClass.description: Workspace claim. guest-opcode-isa requires samples with guest PC units or an exact-hash owned effect declaration.

segments.description: Producer 2.9.0 and later, element rows only: each active segment for this table with its evaluated placement. placed segments fill real slots at offset; relative segments read an imported global, directly or through a defined global, and fill no listed slot; out-of-range segments end past the table's declared minimum and are not placed; unresolved offsets are outside the evaluated constant subset.

monotonic_time_ns.description: Monotonic time of the accepted observation event, copied from the native event. Optional: documents written before this field remain valid.

nativeUint64.description: Canonical unsigned 64-bit decimal, 0 through 18446744073709551615; no sign or leading zeros.

nativeInt64.description: Canonical signed 64-bit decimal, -9223372036854775808 through 9223372036854775807; no plus sign, leading zeros, or negative zero.

monotonic_time_ns.description: Monotonic time of the accepted guest sample event, copied from the native event. Optional: documents written before this field remain valid.

nativeGuestSample.description: Native observation with explicit artifact and invocation bindings. Consumers additionally verify exact sites, artifact digests, PC arithmetic, snapshot bounds, default-arm selection and causal identities; schema validation alone is not evidence of guest semantics.

dispatchClassification.description: Analyzer interpretation of stored artifact bytes. Each site states how control picks the next handler, where the selector value comes from, and whether the dispatch repeats in a selector-advancing loop. confidence is always structural. It never rewrites captured evidence and never raises a VM tier.

site_count.description: Classified sites. Sites found but refused by a work bound are counted in omissions, not here.

omitted_site_count.description: Classified sites not listed: site_count minus the listed sites.

omissions.description: Classification work that a bound refused. Never silent: omitted_records counts dispatch sites found but not classified.

role.description: Derived from the three axes. interpreter-candidate: repeats=loop with cursor_index, cursor_pointer or frame_slot on switch_on_value, handler_table or compare_chain. multiplexer: repeats=once with call_argument on the same kinds; its arms or constants are routing labels and no guest opcode is claimed. other: everything else.

function_index.description: Wasm function index (imports first); null for JavaScript and module-level records.

function_body_offset.description: Wasm code entry offset, or JavaScript function region start.

byte_offset.description: Artifact byte offset of the dispatch instruction or first comparison.

line.description: JavaScript one-based line; null for Wasm.

column.description: JavaScript one-based character column; null for Wasm.

expression.description: Bounded rendering of the instructions or source expression that produced the selector. Inert text.

byte_offset.description: Offset of the closest producing write or load, when it is not the dispatch itself.

arm_count.description: br_table explicit arms, JavaScript case labels, comparisons in a ladder, type-matching table slots, or exported functions.

loop.description: The selector-advancing loop for repeats=loop, otherwise the innermost enclosing loop; null outside loops.

buffer_kind.description: JavaScript cursor buffers only. string flags a tokenizer-shaped loop; it adds no other claim.

matching_slots.description: Real table slot indexes, after evaluated element offsets, whose function signature equals the call's type. A prefix of at most 32. Null when the table layout is unknown.

sequence_gaps.description: Count of absent sequence IDs between observed minimum and maximum per session/process within event_window scope, including gap markers. Late arrivals close holes; duplicate IDs do not create gaps. Unknown prefixes and tails are not counted.

ErrorCode.description: Stable bounded application reason. invalid_request/state_conflict/protocol_error are coarse classifications; precise reasons are only supplied by migrated source paths. application_failed does not imply rollback or no side effects. missing_fields.description: Names from the embedded request contract only; never submitted values or validator diagnostics.

ErrorDetails.description: Allowlisted bounded metadata only. Empty when no detail is known. No arbitrary strings, target URLs or IDs, submitted inputs, credentials, raw captures, diagnostics, or stacks. request_body timeout is before action dispatch; command_exchange uncertainty covers interrupted queued/partial writes and missing or malformed replies; it cannot establish whether an action happened. Worker termination does not undo prior effects.

EvidencePackage.title: Origin Trace Evidence Package v1
EvidencePackage.description: Version 1 closed metadata-only evidence package. Validity establishes internal consistency of supplied untrusted metadata, not producer authenticity, capture completeness, source availability, or artifact-byte verification. Semantic checks and canonical digest rules are defined in evidence-package-v1.md.

EvidencePackageUint64String.description: Canonical unsigned 64-bit decimal, 0 through 18446744073709551615; no sign or leading zeros.

EvidencePackageInt64String.description: Canonical signed 64-bit decimal, -9223372036854775808 through 9223372036854775807; no plus sign, leading zeros, or negative zero.

EvidencePackageSelection.description: Exact selected tuple keys. Duplicate identities are rejected by bounded semantic validation; ordering is normalized for the digest.

EvidencePackageProvenance.description: Untrusted exporter assertions, not facts established by supplied-package validation. Historical producer/browser build and capture configuration are unavailable in v1.

EvidencePackageEventCoverage.description: Retained-source scan and selection assertions never establish complete capture. Runtime checks exact counts, requested/read state, scoped gaps, and applicable limitations. Limitation order is normalized.

EvidencePackageArtifactCoverage.description: Retained-source scan and selection assertions never establish complete capture. Runtime checks exact counts, requested/read state, scoped gaps, and applicable limitations. Limitation order is normalized.

EvidencePackageEventMetadata.description: Closed native metadata projection. Unknown category/type values and native gap records are not ordinary selectable events. Missing historical optional metadata is explicitly null; it is never fabricated as zero. A non-null operation requires web_audio/api_call, exact registry membership, and untruncated payload metadata.

EvidencePackageArtifactByteSize.description: Original artifact byte count as canonical unsigned decimal, at most 16777216 bytes. Artifact bytes are omitted and are not reverified by this validator.

EvidencePackageArtifactMetadata.description: Closed artifact metadata projection. The verification string is an untrusted export-time assertion. Kind, sensitivity, and capture-origin/context consistency are checked semantically. No URL, MIME, filesystem path, source text, or bytes are permitted.

EvidencePackageRelationship.description: Every nonzero source reference has exactly one relationship. Runtime checks origins, resolution state, included targets and selected parent cycles. A creator sequence has no process identity in v1 and must remain unresolved with a null target.

EvidencePackageSequenceDiscontinuityGap.description: Inclusive nonempty sequence-hole observation within the selected stream window. This untrusted retained-source assertion is not independently re-established from omitted records.

EvidencePackageMissingReferenceGap.description: Must correspond exactly to a missing_in_retained_source relationship. Artifact creator identity is incomplete, not a claim of source absence.

EvidencePackageGap.description: Closed safe coverage observations. Never contains raw payload or explanatory free text. Gap occurrences and sequence holes are not summed as unique lost events.

EvidencePackageValidationIssue.description: Safe bounded diagnostics only. No attacker-controlled keys, pointers, messages, paths, or excerpts are echoed.

EvidencePackageValidationResult.description: HTTP 200 is validation data, not acceptance. package_id is null unless the supported package digest matches. Unsupported package versions/profiles are not interpreted best-effort. A valid result does not attest provenance or reverify artifact bytes.

JavaScriptSourceRange.description: Half-open offsets in exact original UTF-8 bytes, at Unicode scalar boundaries.

JavaScriptSourceFactsWorker.description: Bounded Rust/Oxc lexical facts. IDs are local to exactly the supplied source bytes. Total facts across the five arrays cannot exceed max_facts. See protocol/javascript-source-facts-v1.md.

JavaScriptSourceFacts.description: Worker facts bound to fully verified immutable JavaScript artifact identity. Original source is never executed or rewritten. Complete coverage means complete within the declared lexical profile, not runtime or cross-artifact proof.

EvidenceComparisonRequest.description: Original nested package JSON tokens, each at most 4194304 bytes, are independently duplicate-rejecting validated before canonicalization. Only exact declared metadata comparison is supported. Facets select full retained sections; no heuristic or URL matching. Outer keys must be unique and supported.

EvidenceComparisonResult.description: Equality is limited to declared selected metadata. A null selected_metadata_equal means no selected record rows were present. Full keys are exporter declarations, not independently authenticated capture ownership. Cross-scope candidates are counted but never paired. A declared hash/size match does not verify omitted raw bytes. Nested differences summarize type/count without claiming those summaries establish equality. Stable result identity excludes page offset/limit; row identity includes exact input package IDs and facet/key references.
